title: Formal Adequacy Index (based on Polish-language material)
abstract: arXiv:2611.23482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linguistic formality is one of the dimensions of stylistic variation in speech; however, simply measuring its level does not allow us to determine whether the chosen mode of communication is appropriate in a given situation. The aim of this article is to present the concept of a formal adequacy index (based on Polish-language material), which enables a quantitative assessment of how well the formality of a text matches the expectations arising from the communicative context. The proposed approach is based on the separate modelling of observed formality, determined on the basis of the linguistic features of the text, and expected formality, determined on the basis of the characteristics of the communicative situation. Adequacy is assessed by comparing these two measures, taking into account contextual tolerance thresholds, which may differ for a lack of formality and an excess of formality. translated_title: 正式度得体指数（基于波兰语语料）
translated_abstract: 语言正式性是言语风格变异的维度之一；然而，仅仅测量其水平并不能确定所选的交流方式在特定情境中是否恰当。本文旨在提出正式度得体指数的概念（基于波兰语语料），该指数能够对文本的正式性与交际情境所引发的期望之间的匹配程度进行定量评估。所提出的方法基于对两种正式性的分别建模：根据文本语言特征确定的观察正式性，以及根据交际情境特征确定的期望正式性。通过比较这两种度量并考虑语境容忍阈值来评估得体性，且针对正式性不足与正式性过度的容忍阈值可以不同。文中阐述了该指数的潜在应用。
tldr: 本文提出基于波兰语语料的正式度得体指数，通过分别建模观察正式性与期望正式性并引入可区分正式性不足与过度的语境容忍阈值，实现了对文本正式性与交际情境匹配程度的定量评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Formal Adequacy Index based on Polish-language material that quantitatively assesses how well a text's formality matches communicative expectations by separately modeling observed and expected formality, with contextual tolerance thresholds for both insufficient and excessive formality.
